messages:
elaine: quick heads up, opening a docs PR that combines an air-gapped install checklist, VLAN/MTU notes for HSM networks, and a tiny containerd import example. tagging ops + sec.

ben: ack. please add explicit MTU troubleshooting commands (ifconfig/ip link) and a note about jumbo frames causing drops when not configured end-to-end.

owen: for HSM access I prefer documenting an SSH jump + local-forward approach (autossh) and also a short example using stunnel for TLS-wrapped TCP if customers need encrypted tunnels.

maya: agree on autossh. for stunnel include an example client config and mention that stunnel requires cert management. keep the stunnel snippet minimal so ops can copy/paste.

elaine: putting both autossh and stunnel examples in the HSM section. autossh unit will show User=redwoodops and key-based auth. stunnel example will show `accept = 127.0.0.1:4632` and `connect = 10.11.12.13:4632`.

ben: small nit 39 list SoftHSM path as example: `/usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so` and say vendor libs will differ. add pkcs11-tool example to validate slots.

owen: also add a short note about firewall rules when using routed VLANs: an nftables snippet to allow only the bastion/router IP to reach the HSM port.

elaine: added nftables snippet and apt/yum mirror pointers for air-gapped package hosting (aptly and createrepo examples). kept package examples minimal.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4456 branch: docs/onprem/airgap-vlan-mtu-hsm. Reviewers requested: @ben @owen @security-team

security-bot: flagged: include explicit guidance to rotate HSM admin credentials and do not store PINs in plaintext. Recommend using KMS/HSM integration docs for secrets management.

ben: will review MTU and firewall sections later today. if all good i'll request merge.

elaine: thanks all 389 I'll resolve comments and follow up with a troubleshooting PR that contains tcpdump and journalctl examples.
